name: The Forge Path
flavor: You followed the sparks. From the studio itself, through the games, into the oracle — the vault's core sequence, unlocked.

name: Signal Seeker
flavor: Signal found. You traced the live pulse of this studio from dispatch to metric to machine. Few go this deep.

name: The Vault Believer
flavor: The vault recognizes you. You walked the membership path — curiosity → commitment → the locked door that opens.

name: World Builder
flavor: You don't just play worlds — you understand them. Games. Roadmap. Community. You're here for the long arc.

name: The Chronicler
flavor: Every change. Every ship. Every word. You tracked the record of this studio — the vault is a living document, and you read it.
